records.criterion: Reproduce the approximately two-thirds-visible long thread with synthetic content and identify which widget/layout owns clipping and scrolling.

evidence.detail: qt_github_conversation_panel and qt_conversation_cards_view pass with synthetic long bodies. The integrated index is compact, one selected QTreeView detail owns complete bodies, and the former competing full-card/detail presentation no longer creates two body scroll owners.

records.criterion: All admitted thread text is reachable through a deliberate reading interaction at representative widths, fonts and display scales.

evidence.detail: Focused panel tests pass at 900/1400 pixel widths and 13/20 point fonts, with workbench and graph coverage at 1x, 1.25x and 2x. A network-isolated Cocoa run passed at DPR 2 with nonzero complete-detail ranges for all four width/font pairs.

records.criterion: Wheel, trackpad and keyboard scrolling remain responsive; record before/after observations or measurements and prevent unintended competing scroll regions.

evidence.detail: Angle-wheel, pixel-wheel, Home, End and PageUp assertions pass against the single detail owner, including native Cocoa DPR 2. Physical trackpad judgment remains queued as candidate rfc0037-discuss-thread-reading in docs/verification/reviews/rfc-bpr-0037-thread-reading-v001/candidate-manifest.json.

records.criterion: Expansion, refresh and thread selection preserve sensible focus and reading position; distinguish resolved/collapsed state from body truncation.

evidence.detail: Panel and workbench regressions preserve selected post/root identity and reading position across refresh, reflow and Discuss round trips. Narrow Up/Down remains in the index until explicit Return, and resolved/outdated state remains metadata rather than truncation.
